sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on the above, the three levels of peace (in Shlomo's time, the first era of Mashiach, and the second era) correspond to the three levels in Torah.

translations.translation: And based on all the above, we can explain,
that although the matter of "He redeemed in peace" also existed in the days of Shlomo,
nevertheless,
the perfection of this will be in the days of Mashiach,
and in the days of Mashiach itself, in the second period,
for it can be said,
that these three levels of peace
(in the days of Shlomo,
in the first period of the days of Mashiach and in the second period)
are analogous to the three levels mentioned above in Torah.
And the explanation is,
that this that the Queen of Sheba heard the fame of Shlomo was through his name
(for "name" is an illumination)
being drawn and spread to distant places, even to the land of Sheba,
while Shlomo himself was in his place, and his name
(the fame of Shlomo)
was drawn and reached Sheba,
and the more the drawing is drawn to a more distant place, it becomes more diminished.
And similarly regarding the clarification itself,
that even after the Queen of Sheba heard the fame of Shlomo,
it was necessary that "she came to Jerusalem"35
(that the journey from Sheba to Jerusalem takes time and effort, etc.),
and only then was the clarification accomplished
(analogous to the clarification through the revealed aspect of Torah).
But not so the clarification that will be in the days of Mashiach,
for then,36
there will be the revelation of the Ein Sof blessed is He that precedes the tzimtzum,
and this light is equally in every place,37
therefore the clarification then will be
(not in a manner of drawing and descent of the light downward,
and elevating the clarified upward,
but rather)
that the light as it is will shine in every place,
therefore then38
"I will turn to the peoples"
(as they are in their existence and in their place)
etc. "all of them etc. to serve Him with one accord."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: In the first era of Mashiach the revelation is from above without change in nature, while in the second era the revelation will be according to the nature of the world itself.

translations.translation: However, within this itself there is a distinction between the first period and the second period.
For in the first period there will be no innovation in the order of creation,
the G‑dly revelation that will be in the world will be from the revelation of the Ein Sof blessed is He that shines in every place,
but not from the world itself,
since the world continues its natural course.
Therefore the revelation of the creations then
(and their nullification)
will be like something additional to their existence.
[And in the manner of39
the comprehension and grasp of the inner dimension of Torah,
which is like something additional to the person,
therefore change or at least weakening applies to it,
as above].
But not so in the second period of the days of Mashiach, when there will be a change and innovation in the order of creation,
it can be said,
that the revelation in the world
(and the nullification in the creations)
will also be from the nature and definition of the world itself.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The three interpretations of "He redeemed in peace my soul" are all Torah and one unified matter, and through current Torah study one will merit Mashiach's Torah of vision.

translations.translation: Now, the three interpretations
(and levels)
above of "He redeemed in peace my soul,"
since all the interpretations are in the same verse,
they are related to each other,40
and come in one continuum.
For in addition to this that all the levels are Torah
[for just as in prayer,
even the prayer of Shabbos,
although the clarification of Shabbos is in a manner of rest,41
nevertheless,
even the prayer of Shabbos its matter is prayer,
so too regarding Torah,
that even the revealed aspect of Torah which is in the category of enclothing,
its matter is Torah],
indeed all the levels of Torah are one matter,42
one Torah.
Therefore,
through the study of Torah now
(even the study of the revealed aspect of Torah)
they will merit the Torah of Mashiach which is the category of sight,
as is known regarding the matter of "and his study43
in his hand."44
